mcq.question: What is the difference between `regex_match` and `regex_search`?

options.B: `regex_match` needs the whole string to match; `regex_search` finds a match anywhere
options.D: There is no difference since C++17

mcq.explanation: That is why `is_ticket_id("see SUP-20417")` is false.

mcq.question: In `regex_replace(text, ipv4, "$1.x")`, what is `$1`?

options.A: The first character of the match
options.C: The text of the first capture group: the first three octets

mcq.explanation: Groups are numbered by their opening parenthesis. `$&` would be the whole match.

bonus.question: Regex-based redaction will miss some formats. What other safeguards would you add before sharing customer data?
Add IBAN redaction (two letters, two check digits, then up to 30 letters or digits) that keeps the country code and the last four characters.
